#!/usr/bin/env python3

import http.server
import socketserver
import os
import sys
import subprocess

def check_port_in_use(port):
    """Check if a port is already in use"""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(['lsof', '-i', f':{port}'], 
                              capture_output=True, text=True)
        return result.stdout != ""
    except FileNotFoundError:
        # lsof not available, try netstat
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(['netstat', '-tulpn'], 
                                  capture_output=True, text=True)
            return f':{port}' in result.stdout
        except FileNotFoundError:
            # Neither lsof nor netstat available
            return False

def main():
    PORT = 4000
    
    print(f"Checking if port {PORT} is available...")
    
    if check_port_in_use(PORT):
        print(f"WARNING: Port {PORT} appears to be in use!")
        print("This may cause issues when starting the server.")
        print("Consider stopping the existing process or using a different port.")
    else:
        print(f"Port {PORT} appears to be available.")
    
    print("\nTo start the debug UI server, run:")
    print(f"  python3 -m http.server {PORT} --directory /tmp/mcp-workspace --bind 127.0.0.1")
    print(f"\nThen access the debug UI at http://localhost:{PORT}/debug_ui.html")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
